author: Alucardcastle13
quote:
Simple.. it's the best game I've ever played so far.

The game drives you in as if you were in it. It has that particular touch that makes you embody the characters. Graphics are the best in the history of videogames, gameplay is really decent and everyone knows it. The story??? Omg, I love this story too! The ending blew my mind. The story is very similar to what happens to the life of characters in The Walking Dead; it's the apocalipsis zombie what do you people expect??? things not always happen the way everybody wants and that is what I enjoyed about it, even if characters such as protagonist are to be finished off. Embrace it! Ioved Joel with the guitar!
It's a 9 for me bec they killed Joel and it would be nice if they add multiplayer mode but gave it 10 to help the score against haters!

author: Alucardcastle13
quote:
STOP! This game is TRASH!

This game is by far the worst game I ever played in my life! It ****!
I bought it, played it for couple hours and hated it, here is why:

*The voices in Senua's head sound so stupid and dumb, actually sounded like someone with lack of talent reading a godamn script and so freaking repetitive.

*So much unnecessary shaky camera movements that pissed me off because they made me feel dizzy and about to puke! Literally, the camera shakes so much it makes your head spin, plus so much intense bright lights will give you a headache, a headache that for me lasted all night.

*Plus all those stupid nonsense puzzles, nothing but walking, then more walking around, every place looks the same... OMG SO BORING MAN!!! So boring and annoying that I found myself retuning it back to the store right next day. I felt better by leaving this comment here. Rated 1 to show comment but deserves ZERO. Thank you!
